register.labelZh: FOLD 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: 你可以用 fold in、fold round 和 fold over,描述毛毯、毛巾或布料如何包住和保護人或物。；談論可以摺起收藏的床、桌子、座椅和其他物件時,fold away 和 fold down 十分實用。；製作蛋糕、忌廉混合物和其他鬆軟食物時,fold in 和 fold into 可以準確表示輕輕拌入材料。；fold back、fold over 和 fold down 能幫助你準確描述書頁、紙角、袖口、封口或布邊的摺法。
register.summaryEn: You can use fold in, fold round and fold over when describing how a blanket, towel or cloth covers and protects something. Fold away and fold down are useful when talking about beds, tables, seats and other objects that can be stored in a smaller space. Fold in and fold into describe the gentle mixing method used when making cakes, cream mixtures and other light foods. Fold back, fold over and fold down help you describe exactly how a page, corner, sleeve, flap or edge is moved.
